quest.title: Final Match Concludes, Champion Decided
quest.description: The martial arts challenge has come to an end. It is time to decide on the champion...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Mystic Enhancement Ore x2

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: #I believe you have already made up your mind, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Sieciech
dialogues.text: Ahem. Let me recall my lines...

dialogues.speaker: Sieciech
dialogues.text: This has been a truly spectacular and thrilling competition, and now, it is time to announce the results.

dialogues.speaker: Sieciech
dialogues.text: #We would like to invite our Final Trial Warden, {NICKNAME}, to name the champion from among the three finalists.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh? So {NICKNAME} gets to choose the final winner? Whoa... this has to be a first. Looks like {NICKNAME} has become the most important judge in this challenge!

choices.text: The winner is the cutest little pup, Gaumaru!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah, Paimon agrees that Gaumaru was the strongest of them all too! There's definitely a bit of Taroumaru in that pup!

response.speaker: Gaumaru
response.text: Awoo! Awoooo!

response.speaker: Sumire
response.text: Great job, Gaumaru! Your hard work has paid off in the most glorious way!

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: My sincere congratulations to our two friends from Inazuma. This is a well-deserved win.

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: I agree. Our peppy little Ninken here was quite a force to be reckoned with indeed.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: While we're not holding a grand prize ceremony, I'd say that you all value practical combat and tend to keep a low profile in your daily lives anyway.

response.speaker: Sieciech
response.text: #This honor coming from {NICKNAME} {M#himself}{F#herself} is just about the highest honor one can receive in Nod-Krai, and one that far surpasses ordinary trophies and medals.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hehe... You folks are probably the very first in the whole of Teyvat to receive a prize from {NICKNAME} in this manner...

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: We do not need any pomp or ceremony. This is more than enough.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: Isn't that so, Budanova?

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: Of course! Maybe my people can host the challenge the next time, and make it an even bigger affair.

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: We should have at least a hundred competitors in the qualifiers to start with. That way, we might be able to discover some unknown or unaffiliated talents.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: That makes a lot of sense. The Bombardiers will also be pleased to organize something like this. I shall write up a proposal for Major Valeriy.

response.speaker: Sumire
response.text: The Shuumatsuban will also... Um... If organizing this thing is going to cost tens of millions of Mora, then never mind. But the Ninken troop will take part nevertheless.

response.speaker: Gaumaru
response.text: Woo...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I thank each and every one of you for your kind offers. However, it is my opinion that once a competition like this is held and funded by a powerful faction, things may be a little different.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Would any of you be able to resist the temptation to recruit any unaffiliated competitor who performs well, for example?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, Kazuha, do you mean...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: That's right. The best candidate to host a competition like this would be the relatively neutral Adventurers' Guild.

choices.text: Yes, we have to keep the competition free of any other interests.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... Paimon thinks she gets it too! Allow Paimon to state things bluntly then...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Although the two Fatui contestants this time round have been really polite, some of your colleagues can be super mean, and even get right to attacking us without giving us the chance to speak.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If the Fatui end up running this competition, who's to say they won't end up recruiting the top finishers? And that means we'd basically be... helping you scout out talent to fight against us!

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: Haha, there's no denying that now...

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: I hear what you two are saying. But I can't make any promises on behalf of the others.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: Different units have different missions and ways of doing things. And the words of this mere junior officer do not hold much weight.

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: #Mr. Kaedehara makes a valid point. And {NICKNAME} and Paimon's concerns are just as understandable.

response.speaker: Sumire
response.text: Alright, you two, stop scheming and just enjoy the thrill of combat like Gaumaru over here!

response.speaker: Gaumaru
response.text: Ruff! Ruffff!

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: You are right. A foot soldier like me should leave matters like this to my senior officers and focus solely on combat.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: The next time we face off, you can expect to see improvements in my skills!

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: And I... will make sure to bring enough cake for everyone!

choices.text: He's right. The competition must be held only for competition's sake, and nothing else.
I declare Onyx Agate to be the most outstanding competitor of them all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... It must've been tough dealing with this big and tall Fatuus wielding a greatsword, alright...

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: Who? Me? Thank you for this honor. It really means a lot to me.

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: #Everyone has done pretty well. My guess is, I was just fortunate enough to get a better bead on {NICKNAME}'s pace.

response.speaker: Gaumaru
response.text: Ruff!

response.speaker: Sumire
response.text: See that, Gaumaru? You must learn from Onyx Agate.

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: Nicely done, Bombardier Poruchik Stepanyan. I'm sure Major Valeriy will also be proud of you.

choices.text: In my opinion, the winner is Diminished Seventh Arpeggio.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Paimon remembers now! Isn't she the one who trained some of those hat-wearing Fatui we fought in Fontaine? That is seriously impressive alright!

response.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
response.text: #Oh, the two of you are too kind... I'll have to prepare more premium sweets for {NICKNAME} from now on.

response.speaker: Gaumaru
response.text: Coo?

response.speaker: Sumire
response.text: If you want a taste of Ms. Budanova's cakes too, you'll have to work on getting stronger first!

response.speaker: Onyx Agate
response.text: Ah, we were up against a veteran Fatui instructor after all... That's just too hard to match.
